original_description: Activate a session guardrail that prevents writing lesson prose directly — enforcing the rule that all educational content must go through the content-implementer subagent. Use when starting content creation sessions to catch violations of the "never write lesson content directly" rule from CLAUDE.md. Invoke with "/no-direct-content" to enable the guardrail for this session.
best_description: Activate a session guardrail that prevents writing lesson prose directly — enforcing the rule that all educational content must go through the content-implementer subagent. Use when starting content creation sessions to catch violations of the "never write lesson content directly" rule from CLAUDE.md. Invoke with "/no-direct-content" to enable the guardrail for this session.
final_description: Use when the user wants to prevent themselves from writing lesson files directly during a content session. Typical requests: "enforce content-implementer usage", "set up content guardrails", "block direct lesson writes", "turn on safety nets before a content sprint", or any mention of avoiding past incidents with hallucinated stats or missing frontmatter from direct writing. Also triggers for "activate no-direct-content". This skill installs a session-scoped hook that blocks Edit/Write to lesson .md files under docs/, requiring all lesson prose to go through the content-implementer subagent instead. Activate at the start of any content creation session as a safety net.
